SELECT o.order_no,o.member_id,o.total_amount,o.status,o.create_time, CASE WHEN c.order_no IS NULL THEN FALSE ELSE TRUE END AS inventory_confirmed, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM trade_after_sale r WHERE r.order_no=o.order_no AND r.status IN ('REQUESTED','AWAITING_RETURN','RETURNED','WAIT_REFUND','REFUNDING')) AS active_refund, s.carrier_code,s.tracking_no,s.shipped_at,s.received_at FROM trade_order o LEFT JOIN trade_inventory_confirmation c ON c.order_no=o.order_no LEFT JOIN trade_shipment s ON s.order_no=o.order_no
ORDER BY o.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE trade_order SET status=#{targetStatus}, update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE order_no=#{orderNo} AND status=#{expectedStatus}
